info.name: Custom Clean Look
info.description: A simple, clean, and modern design that enhances readability and aesthetics. This style changes the background to a soft gray, improves text clarity with darker fonts, and adds subtle styling to headers for a fresh look. Perfect for a more comfortable browsing experience!
info.additionalInfo: This custom style is ideal for users who prefer a minimalist and uncluttered layout. Using neutral tones and clear typography reduces visual distractions and makes content easier to read. It also introduces small design tweaks, like a border around the header for a more polished appearance. The style can be applied to any website, offering a smooth, consistent browsing experience across various pages.
